name: ZTQ-15 (Type 15) light tank
armament: 105 mm rifled gun with autoloader (gun-launched ATGM capable)
protection: Light steel/composite hull with modular add-on armour and ERA packages for the turret; hydropneumatic suspension for high-altitude terrain. Game: treated as an IFV-class hull: immune to small-calibre rounds, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear, every launcher penetrates.
visual_notes: Compact angular turret with slab-sided add-on armour modules and a rear bustle
Six road wheels per side, hydropneumatic suspension, side skirts
Long 105 mm gun with fume extractor and muzzle brake
RWS with 12.7 mm on turret roof, smoke dischargers in banks on turret sides
Built for the Tibetan plateau and Xinjiang; often in desert/high-altitude camouflage
